C-MULTI-SOURCE-WORKSPACE.Name: Multi-source workspace: explicit Add/Replace routing, root-labeled results and degradation-safe restore for the multi-root sidebar
C-MULTI-SOURCE-WORKSPACE.Summary: The sidebar already stores multiple roots (`projectTrees[]`), watches and closes them independently, searches every root and restores the root set at launch — but the surfaces that open folders route inconsistently: the File-menu picker and Recent folders ADD, while folder drag-drop and clipboard-folder open REPLACE by silently closing foreign roots with no dirty-document protection; there is one overloaded "Open Folder…" command; search results and tabs carry no owning-root identity; and unavailable roots disappear silently at restore. This change makes the owner-approved multi-source experience explicit: one `OPEN_FOLDER(pathname, { mode, origin })` dispatcher with add/replace/ask modes, a shared Add-or-Replace chooser for ambiguous inputs, explicit File-menu commands "Add Folder…" and "Replace Workspace…", a save/close confirmation before Replace discards dirty tabs, owning-root labels on search results and disambiguation of duplicate filenames in tabs, a visible notice when restored roots are unavailable, and watcher/tree parity for hidden dot entries — the exact shape of iCloud `.Name.md.icloud` eviction placeholders — so a synchronized iCloud notes root and local project roots can live side by side in one window.
C-MULTI-SOURCE-WORKSPACE.ApprovalBasis: Owner-approved backlog concept "Multi-source workspace management" (mark-private backlog, recorded 2026-10-20 from Dmitry Kononenko's request: keep synchronized notes and large local projects open together without moving repositories into iCloud; the work/multi-source-workspace.html concept is approved). Reference review completed 2026-10-20 (research/2026-10-20-multi-source-workspace-references.md) with VS Code/Zed/Sublime patterns and eight implementation gates. Owner instruction 2026-10-22 «го исполнять, ревью 4 угла, 2 чистых подряд» authorizes spec, plan and implementation under the four-corner review protocol (Correctness/Security/UX/Perf, CornerMatrix, repeated to two consecutive clean passes).
C-MULTI-SOURCE-WORKSPACE.ProblemEvidence: Current-state facts with evidence (verified 2026-10-22): `OPEN_FOLDER_AS_WORKSPACE` closes every foreign root before opening the new one with no dirty-tab check (src/renderer/src/store/project.js:478-500, log marker BLOCK_WORKSPACE_OPENED) and is the router for folder drag-drop (shim `_shims/install-window-globals.js:198-215` → bus `mt::open-folder-as-workspace` → pages/app.vue:407-414) and clipboard-folder open (src/renderer/src/util/clipboardOpen.js:108-131, both direct and App-Store re-pick paths). The File menu exposes exactly one folder command `file.open-folder` "Open Folder…" (src-tauri/src/m009_menu.rs:465-471, 888-892) routed to `ASK_FOR_OPEN_PROJECT` (src/renderer/src/commands/index.js:243-250) which ADDs. Recent-folder activation on the welcome screen also ADDs (`OPEN_RECENT_FOLDER`, components/recent/index.vue:462-464). Search results show only the filename — the folder-path block is commented out (components/sideBar/searchResultItem.vue:20-22). Tab labels are bare filenames with no disambiguation (components/editorWithTabs/tabs.vue:26). Session restore skips unavailable folders silently with only a console.debug marker (src/renderer/src/store/editor.js:671-700). The directory walk skips dot entries upstream (src-tauri/src/m_v1_compat.rs:355-357) but the watcher-side skip does not match the dot prefix (project.js:54-66), so iCloud eviction placeholders (`.Name.md.icloud`, produced when "Optimize Mac Storage" offloads files in `~/Library/Mobile Documents/...`) would enter the tree model through watch events and appear under "show all files" — inconsistent with the walk and confusing junk for the reported use case.

Goals.Goal: One open-mode dispatcher: `OPEN_FOLDER(pathname, { mode: 'add' | 'replace' | 'ask', origin })` in the project store. Add appends via the existing `ADD_PROJECT` primitive (dedup, nested-root and parent-root rejection stay authoritative there); Replace closes foreign roots and opens the new root; ask resolves to add when no roots are open and otherwise shows the shared chooser. Picker, drag-drop, clipboard, Recent folders and the sidebar folder-switcher all route through this one dispatcher with distinct `origin` values.

A shared Add-or-Replace chooser for ambiguous inputs (folder drop, clipboard folder, Recent-folder activation, folder-switcher pick when roots are already open): one dialog, Add preselected as the safe default, Replace labeled as the context-resetting alternative (it closes other roots and their tabs), Cancel aborts with no state change. Explicit commands never show the chooser.

Explicit File-menu commands: "Add Folder…" (keeps the existing CmdOrCtrl+Shift+O accelerator and picker) and "Replace Workspace…" (picker, replace mode; reachable from the command palette, no new accelerator). The overloaded single "Open Folder…" item is replaced by these two; the native menu id convention, both-direction menu↔command consistency tests and the Rust `id_dispatched_only` match are updated in the same commit.

Replace protects dirty documents: before foreign roots close, tabs under them that carry unsaved changes get an explicit Save & Close / Don't Save / Cancel confirmation; Cancel aborts the replace. Non-dirty tabs under removed roots close silently; tabs not under any root (standalone files, untitled) and tabs under the kept root stay untouched. Closing one root via its existing X control never closes its tabs (current behavior, now documented and pinned).

Search results carry owning-root identity: each result shows the owning root name plus the relative directory (e.g. `Notes/2026`) under the filename, restoring the disabled folder-path row in searchResultItem.vue.

Tabs with duplicate filenames are disambiguated: when two or more open tabs share a filename, each label shows a dimmed owning-root (or parent-directory) suffix; the full pathname stays in the native tooltip.

Restore degrades visibly: at session restore, roots that no longer exist produce a localized notice listing them and are skipped without blocking the remaining roots, tabs or the active tab; the console marker is kept.

Watcher/tree dot-entry parity: watcher-driven additions skip dot-prefixed names exactly like the walk, so iCloud `.icloud` placeholders and other hidden entries never enter the tree model through events.

Unreadable file open is never silent: opening a file whose read fails (including an iCloud evicted/offline file) surfaces the existing error-notice path with clear localized copy; if any open path swallows read errors today, that path is fixed. No download triggering is attempted in this change.

iCloud linking is by ordinary folder paths only: the standard picker already offers iCloud Drive, `mt_pick_folder` already bookmarks the grant for sandbox re-access (m_v1_compat.rs:166-198), and committed tests represent iCloud roots with synthetic paths (spaces, `Mobile Documents` segment, diacritics) instead of live iCloud state.

Current-state reconciliation ships with the code: M-036's stale single-root PlannedPath/Summary (nonexistent `ProjectTree.vue`, `m036_project.rs`) is rewritten to the real multi-root files; V-M-036 and V-M-011 scenarios gain the dispatcher, chooser, root-label, disambiguation and restore-degradation coverage that today does not exist anywhere in .grace/verification.

Constraints.Constraint: Add never closes an existing root or tab. Replace leaves exactly the selected root open after any required save/close confirmation, and never silently discards dirty documents.
Duplicate-root and nested-root rejection remain the existing deterministic ADD_PROJECT rules in both modes; feedback stays localized and unchanged in meaning.

All new user-facing strings ship as native copy in all ten static/locales/*.json (+ .min.json twins) under the existing dot-namespaced camelCase convention; the repo language is English everywhere else per AGENTS.md.
No multi-window lifecycle, no window-scoped project stores, no cross-window ownership — explicitly out of scope by owner decision.
No user-managed workspace file format and no named-workspace UI; session persistence (`lastSessionFolders`, `lastSessionTabs`, `lastSessionActive`) remains the only workspace memory.

No iCloud-specific entry point, hardcoded `Mobile Documents` path, eviction download trigger (`startDownloadingUbiquitousItem`, `brctl`), NSMetadataQuery integration, or CloudKit usage: an iCloud root is an ordinary folder path; placeholder hiding and read-failure notices are the whole v1 iCloud contract.
Sync conflict copies ("Note 2.md") are ordinary files: shown, never hidden, never merged automatically.

The menu↔command registry stays consistent in both directions (tests/renderer/commands/menu-consistency.test.js) and every new menu id dispatches through the existing `mt::menu-invoked` bridge; Rust in-file menu tests (`no_duplicate_ids`, `every_leaf_has_command_or_is_dynamic_submenu`, taxonomy order) are updated in the same change.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Eviction download UX (needs-download rows, progress, offline retry) — follow-up change; v1 hides placeholders and reports read failures.
Multiple native windows and window-scoped workspaces.
Workspace file format, named/saved workspaces, workspace switcher UI beyond Open Recent folders.
Link index, backlinks, or any per-root metadata beyond what the tree already shows.
Re-architecting the multi-root store: `projectTrees[]`, per-root watchers, multi-root search and session restore already exist and are kept as the substrate.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Renderer suites pass and pin the new behavior: OPEN_FOLDER dispatcher modes and origins; chooser default Add + explicit-command bypass; replace dirty-guard (Save & Close / Don't Save / Cancel) and tab-close rules; root-labeled search results; duplicate-filename tab suffix; restore degradation notice; watcher dot-entry parity; clipboard/drop/recent routing through the dispatcher.

A two-root runtime regression (tauri-shim e2e) covers: add two roots, both sections render independently, replace via the chooser with a dirty tab under a removed root prompts and honors Cancel, relaunch restores the ordered root set and tabs, and an unavailable root degrades visibly without blocking the rest.

Menu consistency holds in both directions with `file.add-folder` and `file.replace-workspace` registered (native rows, taxonomy entries, renderer commands, palette descriptions) and the retired `file.open-folder` removed everywhere in the same commit; Rust m009 unit tests pass.

All ten locales carry the new keys with native copy (chooser title/body/buttons, restore-degradation notice, palette descriptions, updated search placeholder wording); locale key-presence tests cover the new keys.
Opening a file whose read fails shows a localized notice — verified by a test injecting a read failure on a synthetic path (including a path with a `Mobile Documents` segment).
grace lint --path . --assertions current: zero errors; M-036 graph entry and V-M-036/V-M-011 scenarios describe the shipped multi-root behavior with real file paths.
